title: Refactor SQLite Export Schema
description: Refactor the semio-repo CLI export command to produce a simplified SQLite schema with integer IDs, project/bundle/folder/file/section/definition tables only, with kind enums as integers, summary fields, and definition code field.
summary: Refactored SQLite export to produce 7-table schema (repo, project, bundle, folder, file, section, definition) with INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, integer kind enums, summary fields, and definition.code. Embedded schema as Go const. Added 4 tests: TestExportToSQLiteSchema, TestExportToSQLiteEmpty, TestExportKindMappings, TestExtractReadmeSummary. All tests pass.
